hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for prediction market pools implementing a VALS dynamic fee formula (e^[λ*(Δx/L)*σ] - 1). Requires a server-signed sigma parameter in hookData for every swap; fees are taken from the collateral token and routed to a YieldDistributor for share holders. Blocks swaps and liquidity additions when the market is resolved or disputed.
